Summary
: This is the English translation of the Paduka-panchaka which represents a hymn by Shiva in praise of the “five-fold footstool of the Guru”. The short text contains seven Sanskrit verses (including a commentary) dealing with aspects of Tantric Yoga, or “Kundalini Yoga”.
This edition contains the Sanskrit text, transliteration and English translation including a commentary by Kalicarana. Alternative titles: Pādukā-pañcaka (पादुका-पञ्चक), Pādukāpañcaka (पादुकापञ्चक, Padukapancaka).
